course_name_original: Digital Product Development and Lightweight Design (M0599)
course_name_en: Digital Product Development and Lightweight Design
prerequisites: Advanced Knowledge about engineering design: Fundamentals of Mechanical Engineering Design Mechanical Engineering: Design Advanced Mechanical Engineering Design

learning_outcomes.text: explaining the functional principle of 3D-CAD-Systems, PDM- and FEM-Systems
describing the interaction of the different CAE-Systems in the product development process
evaluate different CAD- and PDM-Systems with regards to the desired requirements such as classification schemes and product structuring
design an exemplary product using CAD-,PDM- and/or FEM-Systems with shared workload
To develop a project plan and allocate work appropriate work packages in the framework of group discussions
Present project results as a team for instance in a presentation
independently adapt to a CAE-Tool and complete a given practical task with it

assessment_methods.method: Subject theoretical and practical work (CAE-Team project including presentation and elaboration)

assessment_rules: The overall grade includes a bonus of 20% from the subject theoretical and practical work (CAE-Team project including presentation and elaboration). The examination is a 90-minute written exam.
